# Glossary {#sec-glossary-system-design}

Every notion this tutorial defines, in alphabetical order, with its definition and chapter. The list grows as the
chapters are written.

## A

- **Architectural characteristic**: @def-architectural-characteristic (@sec-estimation-and-the-design-process)
- **Authentication and authorisation** (credentials, sessions, bearer tokens, JSON Web Tokens):
  @def-auth-session-token (@sec-the-web-stack)
- **Availability** (with downtime, nines, error budget, SLO and SLA): @def-availability
  (@sec-estimation-and-the-design-process)

## C

- **Content delivery network** (edge servers, cache key, freshness lifetime, hit ratio, purge and versioning):
  @def-cdn (@sec-the-web-stack)

## D

- **Design process**: @def-design-process (@sec-estimation-and-the-design-process)

## I

- **Interface of a web service** (REST, RPC and GraphQL; safe and idempotent operations, idempotency keys, pagination,
  backward compatibility and versions): @def-web-api (@sec-the-web-stack)

## L

- **Load balancer** (layer 4 and layer 7, assignment rules, health checks, global load balancing): @def-load-balancer
  (@sec-the-web-stack)
- **Load estimate**: @def-load-estimate (@sec-estimation-and-the-design-process)

## O

- **OAuth 2.0 authorisation-code grant** (roles, PKCE, access and refresh tokens; OpenID Connect and the ID token):
  @def-oauth-authorization-code (@sec-the-web-stack)

## R

- **Real-time delivery** (short and long polling, server-sent events, WebSocket, heartbeats): @def-real-time-delivery
  (@sec-the-web-stack)
- **Request path** (DNS, TCP, TLS and HTTP; round-trip time, intermediaries): @def-request-path (@sec-the-web-stack)
- **Requirements specification** (functional and non-functional requirements, workload assumptions):
  @def-requirements-specification (@sec-estimation-and-the-design-process)

## S

- **Stateless service** (session state, sticky sessions, session replication; vertical, horizontal and automatic
  scaling): @def-stateless-service (@sec-the-web-stack)

## T

- **Total cost of ownership** (capital and operating expenses, unit cost): @def-total-cost-of-ownership
  (@sec-estimation-and-the-design-process)
